change.description: Personal exploration, prototype and release workers now share one completion, projection and failure-transition lifecycle while retaining three explicit artifact payload branches.

measurement.method: sealed PC01 _measure_sources implementation against committed HEAD

discoveries: The old postgres_gate fixture intentionally seeds a 4B anchor and therefore conflicts with the current empty-catalog admission boundary before this progression starts.
The old schema facade omits current mandatory tenant and installation anchor fields, so the disposable probe seeded those current fields explicitly.
The first probe had no conversation scaffold; the successful progression created it through Eva's own timeline API before linking the personal intent.
One live Eva1 health request timed out during evidence collection; two immediate follow-up requests returned HTTP 200 and the service remained active with zero restarts.
nonClaims: The 75000-line release budget is not yet met.
The PostgreSQL progression used synthetic data in one temporary database and did not touch live Eva data.
This source consolidation does not itself deploy a new runtime image.
nextRequiredAction: Consolidate the repeated completed-unprojected and latest-state reconstruction of the same three personal-work stores without changing their durable protocol.
